physical_inputs.authority: Retained four-annulus factors and three-case capture; verify exact count/PPE/deposition/radius/split/parameter identities using existing source loader and summary validators.
physical_inputs.limitations: Static geometry and an unestimated split; the regional proxy includes an 80 m basin. This does not authenticate a large-lake regional premise, historical LOVE workflow or compatible panel abundance density.

algebra.regional: U_i=sum_s n_si/(K_si*p_i), r_i=U_i/sum_j U_j, recomputed from exact saved observed counts and unchanged training responses.
algebra.observed: q_i=n_local_i/N_local, fixed conditional observed two-taxon panel. Neither NISP nor annulus areas estimate the abundance ratio.
algebra.affine_family: A=sum_i q_i/a_i; B=sum_i c_i/a_i; T(lambda)=(1+lambda*B)/A; u_i=q_i/(a_i*A); d_i=(q_i*B/A-c_i)/a_i; v_i(lambda)=u_i+lambda*d_i. Require sum(u)=1 and sum(d)=0.
algebra.feasible_ratio: Intersect all inequalities 0 <= u_i + lambda*d_i <= 1 and T(lambda) > 0 with the declared lambda >= 0 domain. Compute endpoints analytically, retaining strict/open bounds where required and an explicit unbounded-upper flag if every slope vanishes. Lambda zero is a zero-background limiting control, not an estimate of zero regional vegetation.
algebra.structural_certificate: The closed two-taxon response Jacobian on free coordinates(v_Betula,lambda) has rank1 with opposite rows. Verify its null direction(d_Betula,1) and exact zero determinant; the feasible family has identical observed pollen under the declared mixture. No solver or likelihood optimization is called.
algebra.no_clipping: Keep all three original signed cases, feasibility flags and maintained negative-cover refusals. A simplex projection is a different output and must not be silently substituted.

evaluation_points.endpoint_neighbors: Use exact rational or Decimal-bound comparisons to classify immediately outside/inside the upper endpoint; binary64 rounding is recorded without clipping.
evaluation_points.purpose: Finite controls qualify the analytic whole-domain derivation; they do not sample a posterior or select a preferred ratio.
evaluation_points.endpoint_neighbor_relative_offset: 1/2^20, exact rational multiplication of the exact feasible endpoint, independently classified inside/at/outside.

No production inverse/Jacobian, optimizer or quadrature helper imported. Independently reconcile all original three covers and signs plus every frozen family point and endpoint inequality.
implementation.domain_layout: A nested identifiability package preserves the original top-level writer module identities and original source-proof products.

tolerances.endpoint_classification: Exact independent rational inequality, not a relaxed floating simplex mask.
